general_advisory:
In the current scenario of weather in the state, farmers have to manage their agriculture for the next two weeks. The following recommendations are made: -
- Maintain moisture in the fields to protect crops from excessive cold or frost.
- Select late-sown recommended varieties for wheat sowing.
- Use appropriate fungicides for disease prevention in potato crops.

advisory: The recommended late sown varieties of wheat are K-9423, K-7903, HI 563, DBW-07, HD-38, HI. 62, PBW-833, PBW-77, HD-3059, HD-327, etc.
Increase seed rate of wheat by 25% for sowing in December.
Top dress one-fourth of the recommended nitrogen amount for unirrigated wheat crops.
First light irrigation must be done 20-25 days after wheat sowing.
Weeding should be done 20-25 and 40-45 days after sowing of Rabi maize.
First irrigate the Rabi maize 25 to 30 days after sowing.
Pour cow dung manure / pressmead in the second or third packet.
Do not burn the stubble, use it as mulch in sugarcane fields.
Harvest sugarcane only when SMS of the supply ticket arrives on mobile.
Distance from plant to plant by distillation in mustard / mustard is 25 to 30 cm.
Lightly irrigate when moisture is low.
For control of major pests of mustard, use Dimethoate 30% E.C.
